answer: In the context of DPIA under GDPR, 'necessity' refers to the assessment of whether the processing of personal data is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued. It involves determining if the processing activity will allow for the pursuit of the legitimate interest and whether there is no less intrusive way of pursuing this interest. This assessment should consider the amount of personal data processed and whether it is proportionate to achieve the legitimate interest at stake, in light of the data minimisation principle.
